properties.name: First baseline. Registered in v0.24.0's window without a checksum, so it has been reporting `no_baseline` on every gate run since — correctly, since nothing could judge it. Set now BEFORE freezing the release manifest, because `without_checksum` named it as the one entry that could not say WHAT shipped, and a manifest with a hole is the thing AGENTS.md says a release must not have. Nothing moved: this records a baseline, not a change.
